zh_CN: 带着经验，再次踏入魔塔。
en_US: Carry what you learned into the tower again.

zh_CN: 剑击和魔法弹都朝鼠标所指的方向发出。
en_US: Your sword and magic projectiles aim toward the mouse cursor.

zh_CN: 第 1 至第 4 层结束后，从三件装备中选择一件。
en_US: After floors 1 through 4, choose one of three upgrades.

zh_CN: 塔中的遗物，仍保留着曾经到访者的痕迹。
en_US: Relics in the tower still bear traces of those who came before.

zh_CN: 哥布林攻击前会停下并发出预警。
en_US: Goblins stop and telegraph their attacks before striking.

zh_CN: 同一种装备可以重复获得，效果会叠加。
en_US: The same upgrade can appear again; its effects stack.

zh_CN: 古塔建成时，守塔人点亮了一盏灯。许多年后，灯仍亮着，却再无人记得最初是谁将它点燃。
en_US: When the old tower was built, its keepers lit a lamp. Years later, it still burns, though no one remembers who first lit it.

zh_CN: 第三层的回声比我快一步。我在墙边歇了一会儿，才明白独自前行，并不意味着没有人曾走过这条路。
en_US: On the third floor, my echo ran ahead of me. I rested by the wall and realized that walking alone doesn't mean no one has walked this way before.

zh_CN: 剑刃上的细小缺口，是每一次挥砍留下的记号。
en_US: Tiny nicks along the blade mark every swing.

zh_CN: 轻薄的手套让持剑的手如风般敏捷。
en_US: These light gloves let a sword hand move as swiftly as the wind.

zh_CN: 杖尖残留的温度，像一团不肯熄灭的余烬。
en_US: Warmth lingers at the tip, like an ember that refuses to die.

zh_CN: 戒面刻着一圈细密符文，微光随呼吸起伏。
en_US: Fine runes circle the ring, their glow rising and falling with each breath.

zh_CN: 磨损的徽章被无数次攥紧，仿佛能为旅人留住好运。
en_US: Worn smooth by countless anxious grips, this emblem seems to hold a traveler's luck.

zh_CN: 暗红的纹路沿刃脊延伸，仿佛仍在脉动。
en_US: Dark red lines run along the blade, as if they still pulse.

zh_CN: 铠甲上布满修补痕迹，却依旧可靠。
en_US: Repairs cover this armor, but it remains dependable.

zh_CN: 鞋底的磨痕，记录着一位旅人走过的漫长道路。
en_US: The worn soles tell of the long road a traveler once walked.
